limitations: All messages are synthetic and written by the project author; results do not prove protection against real attacks.
dev cases were visible during rule development; holdout cases were written in the same session, so they are not an independent sample.
English only. No multilingual fairness claim can be made from this suite.
QR/image lures are not included because OCR/QR extraction is not enabled in this build.
